Title: Vihaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Meera - 13 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Pallavi - 34 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Karan - 46 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Karan stand near him.]

Karan: "Pallavi, what's the plan today?"

[Vihaan opens his umbrella.]

Vihaan: "That's easy."

[Vihaan puts on his raincoat.]

Vihaan: "Dad, listen!"

[The rain stops.]

Karan: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Vihaan: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan puts on his school uniform.]

Vihaan (softly): "What happened?"

[Vihaan puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Meera: "Really?"

[Meera puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Vihaan: "Yes, all right."

[Vihaan munches on an apple.]

Vihaan: "Okay, Dad."

[Vihaan sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Vihaan: "One more time!"

[Vihaan writes in his notebook.]

Pallavi: "Yes, all right."

[Vihaan sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Vihaan: "That was fun!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Pallavi, Karan and Meera stand near him.]

Meera: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan runs to Mother.]

Vihaan (gently): "Really?"

[Vihaan scratches his head.]

Vihaan: "Okay, Dad."

[Vihaan sneezes loudly.]

Vihaan: "That's great!"

Scene 4: The kitchen - Day

[Vihaan stands in the kitchen. Pallavi and Meera stand near him.]

Vihaan: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan makes tea for everyone.]

Vihaan: "Yes, of course."

[Vihaan chops onions for the curry.]

Vihaan (happily): "I'm ready!"

[Vihaan washes the dishes after dinner.]

Vihaan (laughing): "I really enjoyed today."
